## Problem

What can't you do today, or what does Buildable get wrong?

## Proposal

What you'd like Buildable to do instead.

## Type of contribution

- [ ] New archetype / template (runnable or planned)
- [ ] Knowledge pack (data model, screen graph, UI pattern, rubric, playbook)
- [ ] CLI / MCP capability
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Other

## Local-first check

- [ ] This keeps the core local-first (no hosted platform, billing, accounts, managed databases, telemetry, or deployment requirements)
